rules: UniversalModifier: value -1..+1, default 0, weight = |value|, no extra gain, no vertex mask

Add a part as web/parts/<id>.json and list it in web/parts/manifest.json
kind=morph morphs the clay hm08 body; kind=overlay loads extra OBJ clothes
kind=body is a separate dummy (different topology). Anime is MB-Lab AGPL-3.0, not a MakeHuman morph
Pages must ship the whole web/ folder; bump cache in manifest.json and all ?v= URLs together
